title: Samaṇabrāhmaṇā
text: 2. Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānam samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yathābhūtam abhisambujjhiṃsu || sabbe te cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtam abhisambujjhissanti || || 3. Ye- -anāgatam addhānam- -abhisambujjhissanti || || 4. Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yathābhūtam abhisambujjhanti sabbe te cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtam abhisambujjhanti || || Katamāni cattāri || || Dukkham ariyasaccam || la || dukkhanirodhagāminī patipadā ariyasaccaṃ || || 5. Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānam samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā va yathābhūtam abhisambujjhiṃsu || abhisambujjhissanti abhisambujjhanti || sabbe te imāni cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtam abhisambujjhanti [page 417] Saṃyutta-Nikāya. 417 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || || Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhayāminī patipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo || ||
